name: Coastal sand and bank modules
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 isolated natural module groups, each with three-quarter, top and side/underside inset, clear ground/bank seams and actual depth. No landscape montage, houses or people; substrate and plants separate when specified. Water is context/rendered appearance only unless an explicitly named basin is a solid module. Title "T03-SHORE-001 — Coastal sand and bank modules". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".
